title: The Beast
subtitle: Though there is one more form that both the Fragments AND Ainul as a whole can assume. The Beast.
description: The Beast is not a separate entity from Ainul, but rather the complete removal of every restraint normally imposed upon him. It represents the deepest, oldest and most primal aspect of the Whole One. While all Fragments possess Overclock states that bring out hidden power, The Beast is the equivalent state for Ainul himself. It is the ultimate manifestation of everything he truly is.
aspect: The absolute release of Ainul's suppressed instincts, emotions, power and primal nature.

sections.title: Fragment Connection
sections.body: Every Fragment carries a small reflection of The Beast within itself.

sections.title: Overclock Relation
sections.body: Fragment Overclocks are miniature manifestations of the same principle.

sections.title: Ainul Relation
sections.body: The Beast is Ainul's equivalent to an Overclock state.

sections.title: Rarity
sections.body: Exceptionally rare and almost never witnessed.

sections.title: Origin
sections.body: The Beast exists within Ainul and echoes throughout every Fragment. It is the source of the overwhelming ferocity occasionally displayed by Fragment Overclocks.

sections.title: Known Facts
sections.body: The Beast can be assumed by Ainul. The Beast can be assumed by Fragments in lesser forms. It has been referenced but not fully revealed. It is associated with overwhelming power. It is not a separate person.

sections.title: Behavior
sections.body: aggression: Extreme; control: Unknown; selfPreservation: Irrelevant; awareness: Complete.
